title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Data ScientistOur Vision  
AI Garage is responsible for establishing Mastercard as an AI powerhouse. AI will be leveraged and implemented at scale within Mastercard providing a foundational, competitive advantage for the future. All internal processes, all products and services will be enabled by AI continuously advancing our value proposition, consumer experience, and efficiency.  
Opportunity  
Join Mastercard's AI Garage @ Gurgaon, a newly created strategic business unit executing on identified use cases for product optimization and operational efficiency securing Mastercard's competitive advantage through all things AI. The AI professional will be responsible for the creative application and execution of AI use cases, working collaboratively with other AI professionals and business stakeholders to effectively drive the AI mandate.  
Role  

* Develop AI/ML solutions/applications leveraging the latest industry and academic advancements.
* Strong theoretical understanding of statistical techniques, machine learning algorithms and their mathematical underpinnings.
* Interpret and explain model predictions and insights to varied audiences.
* Thrive in an unstructured environment, working autonomously on a strong team to find opportunity and deliver business impact.
* Leverage open and closed source technologies to solve business problems.
* Ability to work cross-functionally, and across borders drawing on a broader team of colleagues to effectively execute the AI agenda.
* Partner with technical teams to implement developed solutions/applications in production environment.
* Support a learning culture continuously advancing AI capabilities.

All About You:  
Experience  

* Demonstrated passion for AI competing in sponsored challenges such as Kaggle.
* Previous experience with or exposure to:

o Deep Learning algorithm techniques, open-source tools and technologies, statistical tools, and programming environments such as Python, R, and SQL.  
o Big Data platforms such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark, GPU Clusters for deep learning.  
o Classical Machine Learning Algorithms like Logistic Regression, Decision trees, Clustering (K means, Hierarchical and Self-organizing Maps), TSNE, PCA, Bayesian models, Time Series ARIMA/ARMA, Recommender Systems - Collaborative Filtering, FPMC, FISM, Fossil.  
o Deep Learning algorithm techniques like Random Forest, GBM, KNN, SVM, Bayesian, Text Mining techniques, Multilayer Perceptron, Neural Networks - Feedforward,  
o CNN, LSTM's GRU's is a plus. Optimization techniques - Activity regularization (L1 and L2), Adam, Adagrad, Adadelta concepts; Cost Functions in Neural Nets - Contrastive Loss, Hinge Loss, Binary Cross entropy, Categorical Cross entropy; developed applications in KRR, NLP, Speech and Image processing.  
o Deep Learning frameworks for Production Systems like Tensorflow, Keras (for RPD and neural net architecture evaluation), PyTorch and Xgboost, Caffe, and Theono is a plus.  
Effectiveness  

* Effective at managing and validating assumptions with key stakeholders in compressed timeframes, without hampering development momentum.
* Capable of navigating a complex organization in a relentless pursuit of answers and clarity.
* Enthusiasm for Data Sciences embracing the creative application of AI techniques to improve an organization's effectiveness.
* Ability to understand technical system architecture and overarching function along with interdependency elements, as well as anticipate challenges for immediate remediation.
* Ability to unpack complex problems into addressable segments and evaluate AI methods most applicable to addressing the segment.
* Incredible attention to detail and focus instilling confidence without qualification in developed solutions.

Core Capabilities  

* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Strong project management skill

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Supply Chain Data Scientist
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About this opportunity:**

The Supply Chain Data Scientist is part of the Hardware Services team and develops data analytics and machine learning solutions that solve business problems in the spare parts management environment. The role combines supply chain understanding, statistical and machine learning expertise, and business application knowledge to strengthen the data foundation, generate actionable insights, support the transformation toward a data-driven supply chain and support supply chain modelling. The role works closely with business stakeholders and analytical communities across Ericsson to translate requirements into practical, scalable solutions.

**What you will do:**

* Gather, interpret, and analyze supply chain data using statistical and analytical techniques, and translate findings into valuable business insights and visualizations.
* Assess data sources and work with the business to collect, clean, preprocess, define, improve, and manage data for analytical use.
* Develop and implement analytical and machine learning solutions, including predictive models, recommendation engines, anomaly detection, statistical models, and other relevant advanced analytics capabilities.
* Help advance the analytics capability toward predictive, prescriptive, and increasingly automated or algorithmic decision support.
* Apply programming and data technologies such as Python and SQL, in line with the needs of the solution and current market practices.
* Communicate key findings and recommendations clearly to business stakeholders and senior management through verbal, visual, and written media.
* Support the transformation toward a data-driven organization and a stronger data culture within Hardware Services.
* Explore relevant developments in data science, analytics, and artificial intelligence and apply them to Hardware Services business challenges.
* Mentor colleagues in the role discipline and share practical knowledge within the team.

**The skills you bring:**

* Supply chain and business understanding, preferably including spare parts management or service supply chains.
* Strong analytical skills, statistics, and the ability to organize, analyze, and present significant amounts of data accurately.
* Data preprocessing, data management, and data quality improvement.
* Machine learning algorithms and artificial intelligence systems.
* Open-source programming languages and analytical technologies, including Python and SQL.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Supply Chain Management, Logistics Management, or a related quantitative field.
* 5 to 8 years of relevant industry experience.
* Demonstrated experience in data analysis, statistical modelling, or machine learning.
* Experience as a data analyst or data scientist in a supply chain environment, preferably related to spare parts management.
* Hands-on experience building and implementing machine learning models.
* Experience with cloud-based machine learning solutions.

**Why join Ericsson?**At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.  
  
**What happens once you apply?**Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

title: Project Leader - Data Science (BCN Labs)
description:
**About us:**  
Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
  
  
In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
  
  
Who you will work with
  

* BCN Labs is a Center of Excellence (CoE) functioning akin to a small R&D boutique startup within the Bain ecosystem, delivering end-to end data-driven client deployable solutions across a wide variety of sectors and industries.
* BCN Labs work directly with other CoEs and Practices within Bain as part of the Expert Client Delivery system and interface with global teams across.
* BCN Labs is first and foremost business thought partner working on intelligent ways of using analytical techniques and algorithms across the spectrum of disciplines that can enable building world-class solutions.
* Our goal is to build a disruptive high-impact business-enabled end-to-end analytical solutions delivery system across all verticals of Bain.

About you
  

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* 6+ years of relevant professional experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, or AI (5+ years with a relevant Master’s degree), including experience leading technical workstreams and providing technical direction and mentorship to junior Data Scientists.
* Proven hands-on experience developing Data Science and AI solutions, with strong foundations in statistical modelling and Machine Learning and meaningful hands-on exposure to Generative AI and agentic AI applications.

What you’ll do
  

* Lead Data Science & AI Workstreams: Lead Data Science and AI workstreams from problem definition and solution design through development, evaluation, and deployment, working closely with business stakeholders and engineering team
* Hands-on Data Science & AI Development: Remain hands-on in developing models and prototypes, conducting technical deep-dives, troubleshooting complex problems, and reviewing critical components of solutions.
* Advanced Analytics & Machine Learning: Design and guide solutions across statistical modelling, Machine Learning, forecasting, optimization, NLP, and other advanced analytics techniques, selecting appropriate approaches based on business problems and available data.
* Generative & Agentic AI: Design and build GenAI solutions using LLMs, RAG, semantic search, tool calling, and agentic workflows, making informed choices across models, prompts, retrieval, context, and orchestration approaches.
* Evaluation & Technical Quality: Define appropriate evaluation approaches for ML and GenAI solutions and ensure strong standards around modelling rigor, experimentation, code quality, reproducibility, and solution reliability.
* Technical Planning & Problem Solving: Translate business problems into analytical workstreams, estimate and prioritize technical tasks, identify technical risks, and work with the team to resolve implementation challenges.
* Mentorship & Team Leadership: Guide and mentor junior Data Scientists through technical direction, modelling and code reviews, and structured problem solving, helping them build stronger technical capabilities and operate independently.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with business stakeholders, domain experts, and engineers to understand requirements, communicate analytical findings and technical trade-offs, and develop solutions that address real business needs.

What makes us a great place to work
  
  
We are proud to be [1] consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for [2] diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents..

Visible links
